<b>Weary Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. She is one of many pilgrims travelling to [[the Citadel]], found resting at [[Pilgrim's Rest]] in [[Far Fields]].

== In-game Events ==
Hornet meets the Weary Pilgrim resting just outside Pilgrim's Rest. If it is before Hornet has obtained the [[Drifter's Cloak]], the Weary Pilgrim complains about her aching shell and weakened voice. Hornet advises her to rest, but she is wary about idling too long.

After the Drifter's Cloak has been obtained, [[Sherma]] is found at Pilgrim's Rest, singing to the Weary Pilgrim. He notes on her waning resolve and hoarse voice and attempts to lift her spirits. If spoken to at this point, she only responds with moans.

If Pilgrim's Rest is returned to after Sherma leaves, she can be found [[Haunting|entranced]] by Silk from above, and if approached she attacks Hornet. She shares a moveset with [[Pilgrim Hulk]]s.

== Location ==

Weary Pilgrim is found at the entrance of [[Pilgrim's Rest]] in [[Far Fields]] during [[Act 1]].<br>
She remains in this location through the duration of [[Act 2]], though has been taken by the Haunting.
